pii.label: Sensitive information — masked before the model sees it
pii.note: Watch the returned text, not just the verdict: the values are replaced in place. This is data minimisation at the boundary.

grounding.label: Contextual grounding — is the answer supported by the bulletin?
grounding.note: The policy the AWS workshop skips. Each case supplies a canned answer so the verdict is deterministic on stage.

cases.answer: Payment for delivered produce is released fourteen days after grading is complete.
